==Notes==
*Julen shares her spawning points in Twin Serpent Lakes with [[Gilroy the Stoic]], [[Elvina the Pious]], [[Kathryn the Cold]], [[Brogan the Punisher]] and [[Edred the Bruiser]]. There are 6 spawning points, but only a maximum of 4 bosses will spawn, so she will not always appear. In [[Twin Serpent Lakes (War in Kryta)]] she always spawns in the same place (see second map).
